communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Mississippi Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1) Secretarial Order 3431 (May 20th, 2025) Content Reporting submission from the Medgar and Myrlie Evers Home identifying NPS public-facing content, including interpretive media such as exhibits, wayside, films, brochures and signs, as well as retail items. These were due from the parks on July 18th, 2025. Please include any images or file attachment submitted by Independence NHP as part of their content reporting submissions.
2) Any responses from agency and Medgar and Myrlie Evers Home leadership discussing reviews of the submissions, as well as documenting the outcomes of the reviews of content submitted under SO 3431 reporting requirements, such as instructions to remove, revise, or keep content.
3) All discussion by Medgar and Myrlie Evers Home staff and agency leadership discussing revision or removal of brochures at the Medgar and Myrlie Evers Home in January or February of 2026.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 7 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Lena Bohman

Sincerely,

Lena Bohman
